newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia stocks computer trading system down.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia stocks computer trading system down.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange said midway through Friday morning trade that its SEATS (Stock Exchange Automatic Trading System) computer trading system had gone down and would not be operating until further notice.
"Due to technical problems, SEATS will not be operating until further notice," the exchange said at about 11 a.m. (0000 GMT).
Australia relies completely on the SEATS system.
